create_class_Discussion: create a Discussion dataclass instance representing a Hub discussion or pull request with title, status, repo_id, and author
build_class_DiscussionWithDetails: build a DiscussionWithDetails dataclass instance extending Discussion with events, conflicting_files, target_branch, merge_commit_oid, and diff
deserialize_event_from_dict: deserialize a raw event dict into a typed DiscussionEvent subclass such as DiscussionComment, DiscussionStatusChange, DiscussionCommit, or DiscussionTitleChange
summarize_class_DiscussionComment: summarize the DiscussionComment dataclass that holds markdown content, edit status, and rendered HTML for a discussion comment
review_class_DiscussionEvent: review the DiscussionEvent base dataclass and its subclasses DiscussionComment, DiscussionStatusChange, DiscussionCommit, and DiscussionTitleChange for Hub discussion event types
